Card Q&A.a: Activate the digivolved Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect first.Since it is newly triggered when you activate this card's inherited effect and the Digimon digivolves, it is activated first according to the derived triggering rule.
Card Q&A.q: When one of my [SW] trait Digimon is played, its [On Play] effect triggers simultaneously with this card's inherited effect.If I activate this card's inherited effect first and digivolve, in what order can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect and the played Digimon's [On Play] effect?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your other [SW] trait Digimon are played, this Digimon may digivolve into an [SW] trait Digimon card in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.
